The main takeaway from our work is that

the biosynthetic potential of a polyketide synthases (PKSs) is limited by the availability of starter units, and that the biosynthesis of novel polyketides may be achieved by engineering the starter unit biosynthesis pathway and/or by altering the specificity of the starter unit loading enzyme.
the biosynthesis of aromatic polyketides is a very versatile and flexible pathway, which can be engineered for the production of novel natural product derivatives with improved properties.
